claim: MAJOR CONCLUSION: On v3 detecting-insults-in-social-commentary, the submission schema gate is fundamentally NOT solvable by lifting designer/aggregator/sonnet in any combination tested. X233 (opus on BOTH designer + aggregator, sonnet on remaining 7 roles, $11.08 total) still produced invalid_submission (missing 'Comment' column). Nine consecutive routing variants — none containing opus-coder — all fail identically. The remaining hypotheses are: (1) opus-coder specifically is required (probe cost ~$250+), or (2) opus on 3+ roles is required (probe cost ~$20-50 per attempt). The practical conclusion is that v3 detecting cannot have its $342 Phase-1 cost meaningfully reduced via single-or-pair role routing — the cost lever is gone.

support.grader_error: Submission should have an Comment column

scope: MAJOR finding. Consolidates 9-deep negative streak on detecting and definitively rules out the cost-savings hypothesis space we explored.

consolidated_finalfindings_on_detecting.total_phase2_detecting_burn: Approximately $53 spent on detecting routing probes (X202 through X233), all negative.
remaining_untested_routings_on_detecting: opus on 3-of-9 roles other than opus-coder (no candidates left if coder isn't in mix)
Phase 1 opus-everywhere $342 gold — only known working configuration

practical_routing_policy_for_detecting: Set policy.json[detecting-insults]: opus-everywhere. Routing cannot meaningfully reduce cost below $342. This is a 'no-cost-lever' task — the family-level policy should reflect that.
limitations: opus-coder probes never run due to high cost; if the SCHEMA gate is opus-coder specifically, the floor could drop to ~$255 but we have not verified.

implications.detecting_routing_exhausted: All cost-savings hypotheses below opus-everywhere are exhausted within the affordable budget. Continuing detecting probes is not worth more cycles.
implications.pivot_to_other_tasks: Remaining Phase 2 queue items: X206 (text-classification 2nd task), X207 (tabular 2nd task), X212 (denoising no-evaluator), X213 (denoising aggregator=haiku), X214/X215/X216 (leaf variants). Highest-value next: X212 to isolate the evaluator cost on denoising, then X214 (leaf opus on coder+designer) for the leaf-bridging hypothesis.

next_actions: Stop detecting probes. Continue to X212 next (denoising no-evaluator cost isolation).
